messages:
anya: FYI nightly eval flagged a big drop on summarization for rwd-3b-v2 using the new int8 throughput profile. rouge fell hard vs previous night.
anya: @jordan @mike can someone triage? looks like many outputs are truncated or malformed.
jordan: on it. which nightly run id?
anya: run 20260318-03 on nightly-runner. quick metrics: 
``
baseline (fp16) rouge1: 42.1
prev-int8 (old) rouge1: 41.9
current-int8 (new profile) rouge1: 37.6  <-- big delta
```
anya: sample outputs show weird token splits and early stops.
mike: wow that's larger than noise. could be calibration/clipping change or per-channel quant tweak.
jordan: grabbed calibrator dump for a few layers, layer group 7 looks suspicious: 
``
mean_shift: +0.14
std_shift: +0.02
outliers(>3sigma): 12 -> 49
scale_median_prev: 0.024
scale_median_curr: 0.018
```
jordan: smaller scales + many more outliers -> aggressive clipping or different dynamic range handling.
anya: @toni did we change clipping params when creating the new profile for speed?
toni: yes, we changed clip_p from 0.999 to 0.995 and set dynamic_abs=False to squeeze ranges for throughput gains.
toni: I can flip clip_p back to 0.999 and re-run a quick calibrate.
mike: repro plan: 1) reproduce locally with seed 42, 2) dump per-layer calib histograms, 3) run the summarization eval with n=50.
mike: commands: 
``
python tools/quant/eval.py --model rwd-3b-v2 --profile int8-new --calib-seed 42 --dump-calib=calib.json
python tools/eval/runner.py --suite nightly/summarization --model rwd-3b-v2 --weights quant/int8-new --n 50
```
anya: starting a small repro on a dev box with seed 42.
anya: tail of the quick run: 
``
[2026-03-18T03:12:09Z] sample=23 rouge1=35.8 truncation=true tail_tokens=12
[2026-03-18T03:12:15Z] sample=27 rouge1=30.2 token_loss_spike=true
[2026-03-18T03:12:32Z] overall rouge1 mean=37.5
```
anya: reproducible locally.
jordan: if reverting clip_p restores scale medians and drops outliers, that's our smoking gun.
toni: reverted to clip_p=0.999 and did a quick recalibrate. new stats: 
``
mean_shift: +0.012
outliers(>3sigma): 14
scale_median: 0.023
```
toni: quick eval pass shows rouge1 ~41.6 (not full run but promising).
anya: excellent, please open PR to change default clip_p back and add explicit whitelist for aggressive profiles.
mike: two action items: 1) add a nightly regression that checks token-loss distribution and tail truncation rates (not just rouge), 2) surface per-layer calib diffs in the regression dashboard.
jordan: I'll add per-layer calibration histogram uploads to S3 so we can auto-diff runs.
toni: will submit PR for clip_p default + workload whitelist today.
deploy-bot: nightly-evals: regression incident created -> INC-2026-418 (assignee: eng-ml).
zara: any impact to prod? was the new profile pushed to hosted?
anya: not hosted. dedicated pool had one customer; ops paused the new profile for that pool. no emergency rollback needed.
anya: plan: 1) toni PR to adjust profile + whitelist (ETA: today), 2) jordan add per-layer hist logging (ETA: 48h), 3) mike add token-loss regression job (ETA: next week), 4) run full nightly after merge and close INC if green.
anya: I'll attach repro artifacts and sample gens to the incident. thanks all. :thumbsup:
